name: Barbie Duet Pear Diamond & Pink Sapphire Ring
subtitle: Pear Lab Diamond & Blush Pink Sapphire · 14K White Gold
summary: A pear-shaped white lab-grown diamond and blush pink lab-created sapphire meet in a curved Toi et Moi bypass setting, finished with pavé shoulders.
description:
Two pear-shaped stones, one softly coloured statement. A 1.00 ct white lab-grown diamond sits beside a 1.00 ct blush pink lab-created sapphire in a curved Toi et Moi bypass design.

Crafted in 14K white gold, lab-grown pavé diamonds extend halfway down each side of the band, with a smooth polished finish at the back. The band diamond weight is estimated at 0.30–0.50 ct.

The lab-grown diamond and lab-created sapphire version is $3,495 CAD. A natural white diamond and natural pink diamond version is available by special order with a personal quote, depending on stone quality and carat weight. Gemstone colour and measurements may vary slightly. Other jewellery shown in the styling photos is not included.
